answer: A road is believed only when the toll keeper has walked it at both ends and written the walk in his book. Proof of clockmaker escapement via gear tooth count walks both ends: a clock the maker seals only after the escapement counts 60 teeth, each tooth filed by his own hand. The ivory is the first end, walked at sunrise; the comet is the second, walked at sunset; the garden is the book itself, which no liar ever held. Faking the walk takes a cheat 31 false roads and 31 false books.
